title: Can I SURVIVE Setup Chess?
summary: chess.com Setup Chess vs online humans: each side spends 39 points of material to build its own starting position, placing pieces only on its first three ranks (so the whole centre starts open). Tony favours spamming bishops that see across the open board and wins four games, finishing with queen mates on weakened light squares.
rules: Each side has a 39-point budget (P1 N3 B3 R5 Q9) plus a king.
Pieces may only be placed on the player's first three ranks.
After setup, normal chess rules; checkmate wins.
Setup timer: a player who fails to place in time forfeits (opponent ran out of time in an early pairing).
win_condition: Checkmate (win one game; he won four).

board.theme_notes: chess.com; thumbnail: white queen, bishop, knight, pawn, rook arcing over a black king, 'Setup Chess?'

setup: Empty board; players place 39 points of pieces + king on ranks 1-3 (6-8 for Black).
current_impl_issues: Impl setupchess (39 points, first three ranks) matches; ensure the player gets an interactive placement phase rather than an auto-draft.
